site_name: Land to the north of Camilla Road, Gleniston (Camilla Farm), Auchtertool
address: Land To The North Of Camilla Road, Gleniston, Auchtertool, Fife

site_area_m2.notes: Reported as a '25-hectare development' (61 acres). Sits oddly against the reported 280,000 m2 of buildings — the red-line area is likely larger; verify against the location plan on the Fife portal.

gross_floor_area_m2.preferred_rationale: Consistent across SPICe ('almost 40 football pitches' of buildings) and AJ (280,000 m2 across six identical buildings); whether it is footprint or gross floor area is not fully clear from secondary sources.
gross_floor_area_m2.notes: Described variously as building area/site coverage.

max_building_height_m.notes: Data halls up to 35 m ('roughly a 12-storey block of flats'); community council was told 30-35 m pre-application.

number_of_buildings.claimant: Architects' Journal (six identical buildings) / STV News (up to seven buildings plus on-site substation)
number_of_buildings.notes: Conflicting counts preserved: six data halls of identical footprint (AJ, from the architect) vs 'up to seven buildings' (STV, from site plans). PPP stage, so illustrative only.

land_notes: Farmland north-west of Auchtertool, between Kirkcaldy and Cowdenbeath; access proposed from the B925. APRS states submitted plans show buildings covering the ruins of Hallyards Castle, and that a newly constructed ILI battery energy storage system sits immediately east of the site. Community council reported ~25% of the site would be visible from most of the village. Agricultural land classification not established (see project unknowns). SEPA lodged a holding objection in July 2026 pending further flooding information.
